title: Exercise Catalog Batch 3 — Strength and Equipment Expansion
purpose: Temporary implementation input for a reviewed catalog expansion. The runtime source of truth remains lib/exercise-library.ts.

authoringDecisions.contentDecisionOwner: ChatGPT-authored manifest; Codex performs mechanical integration and validation only.
authoringDecisions.videoPolicy: Every videoUrl is null and videoReviewStatus is not_reviewed. Do not research, guess, or add videos in this implementation.
authoringDecisions.aliasPolicy: Do not generate aliases automatically. Add only explicit, unambiguous aliases separately approved by the product owner.
authoringDecisions.collisionPolicy: Stop on canonical ID, normalized canonical name, reviewed alias, or user-owned normalized-name collision.
authoringDecisions.databasePolicy: Generate a new additive, idempotent, system-only migration with exact TypeScript-to-SQL parity, protected-table tests, and read-only verification.
authoringDecisions.historicalMigrationPolicy: Never edit a committed historical migration.
authoringDecisions.manifestDisposition: Remove this temporary manifest before merge unless explicitly retained as an approved test fixture.

exercises.name: Zercher squat
exercises.coachingNote: Hold the bar securely in the elbow crease, brace hard, and keep it close as you squat.

exercises.name: Anderson squat from pins
exercises.coachingNote: Start from stable pins, build tension before lifting, and stand without shifting the bar forward.

exercises.name: Barbell front squat to box
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the elbows high, touch the box under control, and stand without rocking backward.

exercises.name: Double-kettlebell front squat
exercises.coachingNote: Keep both bells in a stable rack position, brace, and squat between the hips.

exercises.name: Single-kettlebell front squat
exercises.coachingNote: Hold one bell at the chest, keep the torso square, and stay balanced over both feet.

exercises.name: Sandbag bear-hug squat
exercises.coachingNote: Hug the bag close, keep the chest tall, and use a squat depth you can control.

exercises.name: Cyclist squat
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the heels elevated, torso tall, and knees tracking in line with the toes.

exercises.name: Spanish squat
exercises.coachingNote: Sit back against the band while keeping the torso tall and the shins relatively upright.

exercises.name: Reverse Nordic curl
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the hips extended and lean back as one unit only through a range you can control.

exercises.name: Peterson step-up
exercises.coachingNote: Use a low step, keep the stance heel grounded, and straighten the knee without pushing off the floor.

exercises.name: Barbell step-up
exercises.coachingNote: Use a stable box, drive through the elevated foot, and control the descent without bouncing.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curtsy lunge
exercises.coachingNote: Step behind on a comfortable diagonal and keep the front knee aligned over the foot.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Cossack squat
exercises.coachingNote: Shift into one hip, keep the working foot planted, and use only a comfortable depth.

exercises.name: Goblet Cossack squat
exercises.coachingNote: Hold the weight close, shift into one side, and keep the working knee aligned with the toes.

exercises.name: Barbell lateral lunge
exercises.coachingNote: Step wide, sit into the working hip, and keep the bar stable over the midfoot.

exercises.name: Deficit dumbbell reverse lunge
exercises.coachingNote: Use a small platform, step back softly, and stop if the added range reduces control.

exercises.name: Barbell walking lunge
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the bar stable, take controlled steps, and stay balanced through each transition.

exercises.name: Backward sled drag
exercises.coachingNote: Stay tall, take short backward steps, and keep continuous tension through the straps.

exercises.name: Forward sled drag
exercises.coachingNote: Lean slightly into the harness, keep the steps steady, and avoid overstriding.

exercises.name: Single-leg extension
exercises.coachingNote: Align the knee with the machine pivot, lift smoothly, and control the return.

exercises.name: Snatch-grip deadlift
exercises.coachingNote: Use a wide grip, keep the bar close, and stop if the added range compromises your back position.

exercises.name: Barbell stiff-leg deadlift
exercises.coachingNote: Maintain a slight knee bend, hinge from the hips, and stop before the back rounds.

exercises.name: Jefferson deadlift
exercises.coachingNote: Straddle the bar in a comfortable stance, brace, and keep the torso controlled as you stand.

exercises.name: Trap-bar Romanian deadlift
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the handles close to the legs, push the hips back, and maintain a neutral torso.

exercises.name: Landmine Romanian deadlift
exercises.coachingNote: Hold the bar close, hinge the hips back, and stand by squeezing the glutes.

exercises.name: Single-leg cable Romanian deadlift
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the hips square and let the cable provide steady tension as you hinge.

exercises.name: Barbell single-leg Romanian deadlift
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the bar close, hips square, and use a range you can control without twisting.

exercises.name: Barbell glute bridge
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the upper back on the floor, ribs down, and pause with the hips fully extended.

exercises.name: Smith-machine hip thrust
exercises.coachingNote: Center the bar over the hips, keep the ribs down, and pause at the top without overextending.

exercises.name: Machine glute drive
exercises.coachingNote: Set the belt securely, drive through the feet, and finish with the ribs stacked.

exercises.name: Standing cable hip extension
exercises.coachingNote: Hold support, extend the hip without arching the low back, and control the return.

exercises.name: Quadruped cable hip extension
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the pelvis level and extend the working hip without twisting the torso.

exercises.name: Standing band hip extension
exercises.coachingNote: Stand tall with support and move the leg back without arching the low back.

exercises.name: Prone slider leg curl
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the hips lifted and draw the heels in while maintaining a stable pelvis.

exercises.name: Standing single-leg curl
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the hips square and curl the heel toward the glute without swinging.

exercises.name: Standing cable leg curl
exercises.coachingNote: Hold support, keep the thigh still, and curl the heel under control.

exercises.name: Razor curl
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the hips slightly flexed, lower the torso and hips together, and use the hands if control is lost.

exercises.name: Glute-ham raise
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the trunk and thighs aligned and pull with the hamstrings without overextending the back.

exercises.name: Reverse hyperextension
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the torso supported and lift the legs only until the hips are extended.

exercises.name: 45-degree hip extension
exercises.coachingNote: Hinge over the pad, keep the spine neutral, and finish by extending the hips.

exercises.name: Barbell floor press
exercises.coachingNote: Lower the upper arms to the floor under control, pause briefly, and press without bouncing.

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell floor press
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the torso square, pause the upper arm on the floor, and press without rotating.

exercises.name: Dumbbell squeeze press
exercises.coachingNote: Press the dumbbells together throughout the set and move through a comfortable range.

exercises.name: Light guillotine press
exercises.coachingNote: Use a light load, lower toward the upper chest only through a comfortable range, and keep the shoulders controlled.

exercises.name: Reverse-grip barbell bench press
exercises.coachingNote: Use a secure underhand grip with a spotter, lower under control, and keep the wrists stacked.

exercises.name: Smith-machine bench press
exercises.coachingNote: Position the bench so the fixed path reaches the mid-chest and press without shrugging.

exercises.name: Smith-machine incline press
exercises.coachingNote: Use a moderate incline, align the bar with the upper chest, and lower smoothly.

exercises.name: Plate-loaded chest press
exercises.coachingNote: Set the seat so the handles align with the chest and press evenly without lifting the shoulders.

exercises.name: Single-arm machine chest press
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the torso against the pad and press one handle without rotating.

exercises.name: Low-to-high cable fly
exercises.coachingNote: Sweep the handles upward and inward through a comfortable arc without shrugging.

exercises.name: High-to-low cable fly
exercises.coachingNote: Bring the handles down and together while keeping a soft elbow bend and stable torso.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable fly
exercises.coachingNote: Stand square, sweep the arm across the chest, and resist rotating the torso.

exercises.name: Barbell push press
exercises.coachingNote: Dip straight down, drive through the legs, and finish the press with a stable overhead position.

exercises.name: Double-kettlebell overhead press
exercises.coachingNote: Keep both bells in a stable rack, brace, and press without leaning back.

exercises.name: Single-arm kettlebell overhead press
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the forearm vertical, brace the trunk, and finish with the bell stacked over the shoulder.

exercises.name: Bottoms-up kettlebell press
exercises.coachingNote: Grip the handle firmly, keep the bell balanced above the fist, and press slowly.

exercises.name: Seated barbell overhead press
exercises.coachingNote: Sit tall against the bench, brace, and press the bar without overextending the low back.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell shoulder press
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the back supported and press through a comfortable path without shrugging.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable shoulder press
exercises.coachingNote: Stand in a stable stance, press overhead, and resist leaning away from the cable.

exercises.name: Machine dip
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the shoulders down, press the handles through a comfortable range, and control the return.

exercises.name: Underhand barbell row
exercises.coachingNote: Hinge into a stable position, keep the bar close, and row toward the lower ribs.

exercises.name: Pendlay row
exercises.coachingNote: Reset the bar on the floor each rep, brace before pulling, and keep the torso position fixed.

exercises.name: Yates row
exercises.coachingNote: Use a modest torso angle, keep the elbows close, and row the bar toward the waist.

exercises.name: Wide-grip seated cable row
exercises.coachingNote: Sit tall, pull the bar toward the upper torso, and avoid leaning back to finish.

exercises.name: Close-grip seated cable row
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the torso steady and pull the handle toward the lower ribs.

exercises.name: Rope seated cable row
exercises.coachingNote: Pull the rope apart toward the ribs while keeping the chest tall.

exercises.name: Machine low row
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the chest supported and drive the elbows toward the hips.

exercises.name: Single-arm machine row
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the torso against the pad and row one handle without rotating.

exercises.name: Plate-loaded row
exercises.coachingNote: Set the chest pad securely and row both handles without shrugging.

exercises.name: Incline-bench dumbbell row
exercises.coachingNote: Lie chest-down on the bench and row the dumbbells toward the hips.

exercises.name: Kettlebell gorilla row
exercises.coachingNote: Hinge over the bells, brace, and alternate rows without rotating the torso.

exercises.name: Dumbbell renegade row
exercises.coachingNote: Use a wide stable stance and row one dumbbell while keeping the hips level.

exercises.name: Prone dumbbell row
exercises.coachingNote: Lie face-down, keep the neck neutral, and pull the elbows toward the ribs.

exercises.name: Band lat pulldown
exercises.coachingNote: Anchor the band overhead and pull the elbows toward the sides without leaning back.

exercises.name: Kneeling band lat pulldown
exercises.coachingNote: Kneel tall and pull the band toward the upper chest while keeping the ribs down.

exercises.name: Wide-grip lat pulldown
exercises.coachingNote: Use a comfortable wide grip and pull toward the upper chest without rocking.

exercises.name: Underhand lat pulldown
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the torso tall and pull the bar toward the upper chest with the elbows close.

exercises.name: Rope lat pulldown
exercises.coachingNote: Pull the rope ends toward the shoulders and keep the neck relaxed.

exercises.name: Assisted chin-up
exercises.coachingNote: Use enough assistance to complete smooth underhand-grip reps without swinging.

exercises.name: Scapular pull-up
exercises.coachingNote: Hang with straight elbows and move only the shoulder blades down and back.

exercises.name: Machine preacher curl
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the upper arms supported and curl without lifting the shoulders.

exercises.name: Cable preacher curl
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the upper arms on the pad and control the cable through the full rep.

exercises.name: Lying cable curl
exercises.coachingNote: Lie back with the upper arms still and curl the bar toward the shoulders.

exercises.name: Cross-body hammer curl
exercises.coachingNote: Curl the dumbbell toward the opposite shoulder while keeping the upper arm quiet.

exercises.name: Zottman curl
exercises.coachingNote: Curl with palms up, rotate at the top, and lower slowly with palms down.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell wrist curl
exercises.coachingNote: Support the forearms and move only through the wrists.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell reverse wrist curl
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the forearms supported and lift the backs of the hands without moving the elbows.

exercises.name: Cable wrist curl
exercises.coachingNote: Hold the elbows still and flex the wrists through a controlled range.

exercises.name: Plate pinch hold
exercises.coachingNote: Pinch smooth-sided plates securely and stand tall without letting them rest against the legs.

exercises.name: Fat-grip dumbbell hold
exercises.coachingNote: Stand tall with the thick handles and keep the shoulders relaxed.

exercises.name: Rope triceps pushdown
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the elbows near the sides and separate the rope at the bottom.

exercises.name: Reverse-grip triceps pushdown
exercises.coachingNote: Use an underhand grip, keep the elbows still, and extend smoothly.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable triceps pushdown
exercises.coachingNote: Keep the upper arm by the torso and extend the elbow without rotating.

exercises.name: Cross-body cable triceps extension
exercises.coachingNote: Draw the handle across the body while keeping the upper arm steady.

exercises.name: Close-grip push-up
exercises.coachingNote: Place the hands just inside shoulder width and keep the elbows controlled.

exercises.name: Machine lateral raise
exercises.coachingNote: Set the pads comfortably and lift only to a pain-free height.

exercises.name: Lean-away cable lateral raise
exercises.coachingNote: Hold support, lean slightly away, and raise the arm through a comfortable arc.

exercises.name: Behind-body cable lateral raise
exercises.coachingNote: Start with the cable behind the body and lift without shrugging.

exercises.name: Prone incline Y-raise
exercises.coachingNote: Use very light weights, raise the arms in a Y shape, and keep the neck relaxed.

exercises.name: Cable Y-raise
exercises.coachingNote: Raise the handles into a Y while keeping the ribs down and shoulders controlled.
